'''Tidewalker δ''' is an [[Elite enemy]] in ''[[Arknights: Endfield]]''.

{{Enemy description|The "Genesklydan Dinedon" (archive ID: AGM321δ) is an energized variant of AGM321. Its constituent matter is in a constant, turbulent flow. This also explains its particularly terrifying form when it appears at night.}}

==Overview==
A unique variant of [[Tidewalker]], the Tidewalker δ has similar appearance with its counterpart, but it doesn't make them less of the threat with most abilities remained:

*Swings with one of its tentacles, followed by a thrust into the ground and lastly a swing, dealing Physical damage.
*Swings with both of its tentacles, dealing Physical damage and knock Operators back.
*Thrusts both of its tentacles into the ground, dealing Physical damage. This is followed by pulling them up, dealing Physical damage to a short distance at front.
*Swings both of its tentacles three times, with each swing creates grounded shockwaves, dealing Cryo damage and {{G|Cryo Infliction}}.
*Fires lasers three times, each dealing Cryo damage, {{G|Cryo Infliction}}, knock Operators back, and leaving marks on the ground. The marks detonate after a short period, dealing Cryo damage and {{G|Cryo Infliction}}.
*Thrusts both of its tentacles into the ground, dealing Physical damage, then extends them into nine areas, dealing Cryo damage and {{G|Cryo Infliction}}. This ability can be interrupted by skills.
